🎨 Palette: Improve accessibility of device action buttons

commits.author: google-labs-jules[bot]
commits.message:
🎨 Palette: Improve accessibility of device action buttons

Refactored the device list's "Actions" to be more accessible and user-friendly.

- Replaced the popover with three distinct, icon-only buttons for "Commands", "View Output", and "Delete".
- Added `title` attributes to each button to provide tooltips on hover.
- Added `aria-label` attributes to each button to ensure they are accessible to screen readers.
- Updated the table header to match the new, cleaner layout, consistent with the project's README screenshot.

commits.message:
Add signup and user management pages with corresponding JavaScript functionality

- Implemented signup.html for user registration with form validation and submission handling.
- Created users.html for displaying user list with options to edit and delete users.
- Developed account.js to manage user session and navigation based on login status.
- Added devices.js for device management, including loading device data and handling commands.
- Introduced login.js for user authentication with password hashing.
- Implemented reverseCommands.js and reverseCommandsOutput.js for managing device commands and outputs.
- Created rmcs.js for managing RMCs with functionality to load and delete RMC entries.
- Added signup.js for handling user registration logic and validation.
- Updated users.js for loading user data and managing user actions.
